## Shutdown addendum

### Landed after the main entry
- Gerrit 2369 'Split the git lock policy out of gitutil' pushed for review (NOT submitted), ticket f802-536b-0081-432a in_progress. gitutil.py 798 -> 373, new git_locking.py 484. Plan-review took 5 runs, 4 genuine BLOCK rounds, no --force. Its first attestation went stale mid-review because docs/concurrency.md landed on origin/main; re-ran and claimed back-to-back to close the window.
  NEXT SESSION: wait for both votes on 2369, Submit, THEN close f802 -- not before it merges.
- The monkeypatch-retarget evidence on that change is the model to copy: 6 of 7 moved names are structurally protected (not re-exported, so raising=True makes a mis-target loud), ONE (_backoff_sleep) is legitimately re-exported and therefore silently mis-targetable -- proven with a seeded mutant where the correct target catches it and the old target passes vacuously. It also declined to claim proof for gitutil.os / gitutil.subprocess, because those are the same stdlib module objects as git_locking's and so are not module-sensitive seams. Honest non-claims are worth as much as the proofs.
- A second vacuity channel found there: getattr(gitutil, '_INDEX_LOCK_STALE_S', 300) falls through silently AND the real constant is 300, so a value comparison proves nothing. Needed a sentinel default.

### Open Gerrit changes at shutdown (mine, none submittable)
  2360  Surface op-cert keys with no public counterpart  -- rerun-llm-review posted for bugfix-size-attestation
  2365  reads: reject a present-but-unusable store       -- premise is the WRONG predicate, see aefe above
  2368  fix(io): JS-safe ns timestamps in export NDJSON
  2369  Split the git lock policy out of gitutil

### Merged in the closing stretch
2353, 2354, 2355, 2356, 2357, 2358, 2359, 2361, 2362, 2363, 2364, 2366, 2367. 42 commits reached main in 18 hours.

### Tickets closed certified this session (verify-signature confirmed, never exit-0 alone)
dewy-rotatable-tarsier (d240), taurine-smiling-hamadryad (9bc0), cibophobic-moist-guineafowl (b928), seaborne-wisdomless-songbird (dd96, obsolete), dire-expectable-terrapin (d26a), oozy-darkish-merganser (daa7), colourless-hasteless-lamb (5ec7), potential-powellite-mouflon (dbca).

### Machine state at shutdown
- No orphaned processes attributable to this session. One leaked watcher was reaped: a 34-day-old PPID-1 watch-tracker.sh from job 09e12a48 with an unbounded 'while :; sleep 0.1' loop, 3.3 CPU-hours, watching a worktree path that no longer exists.
- /Users/joeoakhart/rebar is on main, clean apart from the two pre-existing reb-3115-*.py untracked files.
- 67 worktrees remain. Deliberately NOT pruned: another session is active under the same identity and removing worktrees mid-flight already disrupted one change earlier tonight. Prune only after confirming no session is live.
- One subagent was still finishing the closes for bc5d-ffba-006b-4241 and f449-be6a-be56-4fef; its state is recorded on those tickets rather than here.
